name: charts
title: Charts & infographics
description:
Dependency-free accessible SVG chart library

-charts.js (bar, line, area, donut/pie, KPI, sparkline, progress, gauge, timeline, table, funnel, process, calendar, map placeholder, org chart, stat, compare) styled by the DNA, palette snapped to 3:1 per theme, demo page, rules and previews; skipped when the profile has no dataviz.
